subject.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits

question: Should OpenClaw accept this opt-in `models.providers.*.request.rateLimit` provider-dispatch config surface now, after a rebase that preserves current SecretRef egress handling, or wait for the broader outbound API governance design?
rationale: The code path is compatibility- and security-sensitive, the PR adds new public config, and the related canonical issue still has broader unresolved budget/tool/channel/CLI scope that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Accept provider-dispatch slice after rebase
options.body: Require the contributor to rebase onto current main, preserve `swapSecretSentinelsForEgress`, rerun focused proof, and then review this as the first opt-in provider limiter increment.

options.title: Pause for broader limits design
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define the full outbound API governance boundary across providers, tools, budgets, status, and CLI.

options.title: Close as unconfirmed direction
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers do not want new core config for provider pacing before a sponsored design exists.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-dispatch slice after rebase
recommendation.body: Require the contributor to rebase onto current main, preserve `swapSecretSentinelsForEgress`, rerun focused proof, and then review this as the first opt-in provider limiter increment.
